title: Kimi ga Shinu made Koi wo Shitai

thread.title: I Want to Love You Till Your Dying Day • Kimi ga Shinu made Koi wo Shitai - Episode 12 discussion

opinions.point: Many commenters enjoyed the emotional reconciliation and felt the central relationship was handled warmly.
The lighter domestic material was widely considered cute, comforting, and a welcome release after heavier tension.
Several viewers praised the episode's character development and the leads becoming more proactive and emotionally open.
Some viewers thought the episode effectively captured the series' balance of darkness, tenderness, and hope.
A number of commenters felt the episode played like a finale or penultimate climax, creating uncertainty about what the actual finale could meaningfully accomplish.
Some viewers found the cheerful section and closing developments suspiciously abrupt or ominous despite enjoying them.
One recurring criticism was that the protagonists still do not do enough to drive the broader story or work toward solving its central conflict.
The episode's music and vocal performance received favorable remarks, including appreciation for the fitting theme and duet.

title: Tai-Ari deshita.: Ojou-sama wa Kakutou Game nante Shinai

thread.title: Young Ladies Don’t Play Fighting Games • Tai-Ari deshita. Ojou-sama wa Kakutou Game Nante Shinai - Episode 12 discussion - FINAL

opinions.point: Most commenters found the episode exciting, emotionally engaging, and a strong conclusion to the season.
The fighting-game presentation was widely praised for making competitive play feel accessible, intense, and entertaining even to newcomers.
Viewers particularly enjoyed the character relationships, rivalry dynamics, comedy, and emotional development.
The music, including the prominent fighting-game homage, was repeatedly described as an excellent highlight.
Some viewers wanted a second season and more relationship development, while others felt the season worked well as a complete stopping point.
A minority disliked aspects of the ending, especially the lack of more explicit romantic resolution.
One recurring criticism was that the tournament material could have been shorter and contained too much commentary or exposition.
